title: Canva Code 2 combines AI website generation with Canva's visual editor
description:
Canva Code 2 combines AI website generation with Canva's visual editor, making it easy to customize AI-generated sites without touching code.

Start with a prompt, then edit text, swap images, change fonts and colors, or refine individual elements directly inside Canva. You can even import websites created with other AI builders and continue editing them instead of starting over.

If you've been using AI website builders but wanted more creative control, Canva Code 2 is definitely worth checking out.

#canva #aicode #webdesign #ai #vibecoding
